summary: Phase 4 complete: PlusFormula.BoxStabFree and the Anchored vacuity it buys, appended to FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/Subformulas.lean (256 -> 373 lines, +118 insertions, 0 deletions), zero sorries. Four new declarations: BoxStabFree (seven arms matching subformulas -- True on the two atomic ones, conjunction across the three binary ones, False on box and stab), the hand-rolled decidableBoxStabFree instance, boxStabFree_of_mem_subformulas (inheritance by subformulas, by induction on phi), and the two plan-pinned closure-vacuity lemmas not_box_mem_plusSubformulaClosure / not_stab_mem_plusSubformulaClosure -- which is what collapses an Anchored certificate to its now and atom fields for a box/stab-free phi, for Phase 7 to consume. The phase's interface verification tier was run in full: scoped guarded build of the module (guard exit 0, 707 jobs, 0 errors) then the module plus its two nearest importing aggregators, FormalSystem.PlusLanguage and FormalSystem.Metalogic.Decidability.RaySummary (guard exit 0, 1938 jobs, 0 errors, 0 warnings), .olean newer than source. Both pinned lemmas at exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; boxStabFree_of_mem_subformulas at [propext] alone. BoxStabFree's non-vacuity checked by six computed #evals rather than assumed, three of them nested so the recursion is shown to descend rather than only read the head constructor. TWO DEVIATIONS, both annotated inline in the plan and logged in issues.jsonl. (1) The inheritance lemma does not route through the helpers its bullet named: subformulas_trans says nothing about BoxStabFree, and the eight per-arm membership lemmas CONSTRUCT a membership where this proof must DESTRUCTURE one -- the opposite direction. Landed as an induction on phi mirroring subformulas_trans's own arm-for-arm shape, re-deriving no project lemma, which is what the hint protected; statement and decomposition exactly as pinned, so not marked blocked. (2) Scope Hypothesis band overshot (118 vs ~60-95), docstring prose only -- library code proper ~85 lines, and the binding half (insertions only, zero existing declarations touched) holds exactly. Delegated choice taken: Prop-valued with a Decidable instance rather than Bool with a bridge, because this phase's own #eval decide (...) criterion only typechecks on the Prop spelling. Territory-disjoint from Realize.lean: Phases 1-3's deliverables and the wired evidence probe are untouched. Single-phase dispatch: phases 5-8 remain, and 5-7 stay serialized on Realize.lean.
